name: Webster Vienna Private University
summary: Webster University's Vienna campus (US-based): five English bachelor's in business, politics, psychology, media, computing; law pending approval.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is accepted, with a minimum school GPA of 2.5 out of 4 or equivalent (no IB conversion given). IB English proves English: HL A 4, HL B 5, SL A 5 or SL B 6.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: A structured business core (accounting, law, economics, finance, management, information systems) ending in a market-simulation capstone, with an emphasis in entrepreneurship, HR, international business or marketing.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: your school record (GPA 2.5 of 4 or equivalent), a 300-word essay, a recommendation letter and your English decide; an interview may be asked for.

programmes.name: Computer Science with an Emphasis in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: A computer science core (software, algorithms, hardware, data management) with machine learning and data analysis, applied to fields such as healthcare, economics and life sciences in hands-on projects.
programmes.ib: Needs IB Maths HL (AA or AI) at 5 or SL at 6, a recommendation letter on your tech skills, and evidence of activities such as coding or robotics.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission on your school record, essay and English, plus a teacher's letter on your IT skills and a summary of activities such as coding or robotics.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Research-led international relations: analysing global issues from perspectives beyond your own, with methods training, real-world cases and a thesis.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: your school record (GPA 2.5 of 4 or equivalent), a 300-word essay, a recommendation letter and your English decide; an interview may be asked for.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: The main concepts and findings across psychology plus research methods: you form a hypothesis from current science, then collect, analyse and present your own data.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: your school record (GPA 2.5 of 4 or equivalent), a 300-word essay, a recommendation letter and your English decide; an interview may be asked for.

programmes.name: Strategic Communication
programmes.about: Public relations, persuasion, media literacy, corporate and crisis communication and campaigns, with strategic writing, audience research and practical exercises.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: your school record (GPA 2.5 of 4 or equivalent), a 300-word essay, a recommendation letter and your English decide; an interview may be asked for.

programmes.name: Comparative International Business Law
programmes.about: Public and private law compared across civil and common law traditions, with a specialisation chosen by semester 4 and a senior thesis; it does not qualify you for the bar anywhere.
programmes.ib: Pending AQ Austria and Higher Learning Commission approval; not accredited by the American or Austrian Bar Association.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: your school record (GPA 2.5 of 4 or equivalent), a 300-word essay, a recommendation letter and your English decide; an interview may be asked for.

notes: For 2026 entry the EU/EEA deadline was 31 July 2026 and the non-EU one 31 March 2026; the 2027 dates are not yet published.
New students pay a €1,000 registration deposit before they can register for classes.
